flows.name: Seeded registrations and provider choices are available
flows.action: Open Calculation Registrations and the new-registration form.
flows.expected: The four seed tokens and installed local provider choices are available.

flows.name: Required registration validation retains the editable form
flows.action: Save an empty registration.
flows.expected: Required-field errors retain the editable form.

flows.name: Unavailable implementation cannot be registered
flows.action: Try registering a missing local Groovy calculation.
flows.expected: The provider is rejected with an honest unavailable message; no registration is saved.

flows.name: Create registration persists after reload
flows.action: Create an owned PatientIdCalculation registration, then reload.
flows.expected: The saved token and provider persist.

flows.name: Duplicate token is rejected
flows.action: Create another registration using the same token.
flows.expected: Duplicate validation preserves the original registration.

flows.name: Edit registration persists
flows.action: Rename the owned token, save, then reload.
flows.expected: The edited token persists and the previous token is replaced.

flows.name: Explicit patient selection is ordered and deduplicated
flows.action: Enter two active patient IDs out of order, with one repeated.
flows.expected: Actual patients are evaluated once each, in ascending order.

flows.name: First-N selection is deterministic and bounded
flows.action: Request the first two active patients; then submit negative, oversized and nonnumeric counts.
flows.expected: Selection is deterministic; counts outside the whole-number range 0–1000 show errors.

flows.name: Unknown and malformed patient inputs are visible errors
flows.action: Submit an unknown patient and malformed patient text.
flows.expected: No invented result is returned; the invalid text stays in the form.

flows.name: Empty cohort has an explicit result state
flows.action: Evaluate a zero-patient cohort.
flows.expected: An explicit no-results state appears.

flows.name: Date parameter changes real age without retaining old defaults
flows.action: Evaluate age at the frozen date, then six years earlier; reload and open a fresh form.
flows.expected: Real age changes by six years; the saved definition retains its original behavior.

flows.name: Typed number parameter evaluates submitted values
flows.action: Register the owned Integer parameter definition; evaluate 42 and then 7.
flows.expected: Each submitted numeric value appears in the result.

flows.name: Typed boolean parameter evaluates submitted values
flows.action: Evaluate the owned Boolean parameter with True and False.
flows.expected: Both choices produce the corresponding real result.

flows.name: Typed text parameter evaluates submitted values
flows.action: Evaluate plain text containing angle brackets, then change it.
flows.expected: Actual text is escaped and updates; it is never interpreted as markup.

flows.name: Metadata collection returns real identifiers rather than object hashes
flows.action: Select the local identifier type for an owned identifier calculation.
flows.expected: The result contains real patient identifiers in a collection, without an object hash.

flows.name: Delete cancellation and confirmation work
flows.action: Cancel deletion, then confirm it and revisit the deleted registration.
flows.expected: Cancel preserves it; confirmation deletes it; the resource read returns 404.

flows.name: Remove remaining owned registrations and preserve seed registrations
flows.action: Delete every remaining owned registration and revisit the list.
flows.expected: All four seed registrations remain; no owned registration remains.

flows.name: No external requests or page errors
flows.action: Intercept nonlocal HTTP(S) throughout the headless run.
flows.expected: Zero external requests and zero browser page errors.

flows.name: Invalid typed values retain inputs and explicit patients take precedence
flows.action: Submit bad and missing numeric values, impossible/trailing-junk dates, and valid explicit patients with an invalid first-N count.
flows.expected: Errors retain their inputs; explicit patients take precedence and evaluate.

flows.name: Numeric collections preserve typed members
flows.action: Add two Integer collection entries, 1 and 2, and evaluate.
flows.expected: The real typed collection renders [1, 2].

flows.name: Static metadata collections display local names
flows.action: Select a database location in a static metadata collection and evaluate.
flows.expected: The actual local location name appears instead of a UUID or identity hash.

results.name: Boolean choice remains selected after evaluation and reload
